question: Does a rule chosen on the September King's Chamber distinguish the same survey location on another acquisition and transfer to the Queen and Subterranean positions?
prior_knowledge: Same Giza scenes and labels have been explored repeatedly. New implementation and frozen cross-date and cross-target transfer, no blind site or certified empty translations. No registration or crop choice from chamber brightness.

sources.two_stage: Seyfzadeh 56:37 onwards, 128 x 128 coarse, then 24 azimuth x 32 range fine, and Biondi's range-alignment advice 55:24 https://youtu.be/SjJTRVgr9Mw?t=3397
sources.withheld_wavelength: Seyfzadeh 1:21:44 on not using the journal's wavelength https://youtu.be/SjJTRVgr9Mw?t=4904
sources.equations: Biondi and Malanga, 2022, section 4 equations 20-24 and numerical example. Retracted in 2026. https://doi.org/10.3390/rs14205231
sources.paired_subbands: Biondi patent WO2024008365A1 paragraphs 0004 and 0025 onwards, sonic steering and matched filtering https://patents.google.com/patent/WO2024008365A1/en
sources.comparison: Canini's published complex-shift recipe and two pair lags https://www.accadradinuovo.com/Lab/giza_sar/prova_camere/file/PROTOCOLLO.md
sources.fixed_master: Seyfzadeh's own question in April 2025, first half-band master and shifted copies https://opusmagnum.org/cracking-the-biondi-code-with-ai/

observations: Use Sept 16 and Oct 4 2024 Capella C13 and June 2 2025 ICEYE X50 SLC. Footprint center and plan projections from geo-retest at fixed nominal pavement HAE. 32 translated positions per chamber at 8,16,24,32 m on 8 bearings; separate 32 point common shift ring at 48 m. Use fixed rounded elevation labels relative to pavement, King +43 m, Queen +21 m, Subterranean -30 m. These are coarse known labels for a specificity test, not claimed detections or exact centers. Controls can overlap actual rooms and one another.
tracking: 193 Hamming looks of half-dwell width, centers equally spaced 0.25...0.75 times dwell. C13 uses 2D PFA angle-time support; X50 uses the existing positive linear processed-Doppler-frequency to aperture-time approximation. Two lags: 1 (adjacent) or 8 steps. For each pair use integer-peak circular complex correlation of 128x128 samples, then shift the OFF fine patch center by that integer and refine within 24 azimuth x 32 range samples using upsampled complex correlation. Capella native row = azimuth, ICEYE native column = azimuth. Constant phase-insensitive amplitude metric. These are our replay choices; half-dwell nominal look widths carry far fewer independent degrees of freedom than 193. Native metric patches differ per product. Third branch fixed master at mid-dwell; compare each of the other 192 looks to the one master. This ensures partial overlap even at the ends. Use pair midpoints for all three branches; reuse the lag-1 and lag-8 measurements where the master coincides.
focusing: 23/24-style complex tracked shift y = azimuth_metres + i*range_metres, centered after subtracting common-ring componentwise median per pair. For signed height h relative to pavement and assumed sonic wavelength L, angular steering exp(i*4*pi*Bperp*h/(R*sin(incidence)*L)). Use pair midpoints, no redundant factor 2*pi or undefined time multiplier. Bperp is (1) signed orbit baseline projected onto instantaneous mid-look-orthogonal along-track direction, or (2) same baseline projected onto projected geodetic up in the mid-look elevation plane. Two weightings: ordinary normalized squared complex matched filter or normalized squared whitened filter, scene-specific covariance estimated only from separate ring (0.25 isotropic shrinkage). Subtract mean from both complex atom and signal. Rank on the fixed signed label only. Neither geometry is a measured elastic path.
finite_family: 3 pairings x 2 geometry choices x 3 assumed L (0.24, 0.30, 0.48 m; distinct published examples, none asserted for Seyfzadeh) x 2 estimators = 36. Keep every training and transfer rank. Compare unfiltered RMS of same complex offsets and intact fine-patch median power. Append full target height scans -44 to +44 m at 0.5 m for winner, zero undefined after mean removal. Record peak signed error as diagnostic only, and max adjacent phase increment. Adjoint code unit control recovers a known injected atom on an unaliased grid. No inversion of real rock velocity.
selection: Only use Sept King scores for choice. Maximize strict count beaten among 32 translations; break ties by larger standardized target-minus-control-median (MAD scale), then adjacent, 8-step, then fixed master, along-track first, increasing wavelength, ordinary first. Write a training-only lock with file hashes before calculating the other dates' scores. Reuse winner unchanged. No alternative qualifies as a confirmatory result. Include dated per-scene measurement receipts, raw component shifts and compact portable numerical inputs.
decision: Primary gate on October: each of three chamber positions must beat at least 31/32 translations and strictly beat its own two baseline ranks (RMS offsets, median SLC power). Same gate separately on ICEYE as a secondary transfer with different front end and polarization. Report all ranks, training rank, sensitivity to alternative settings, unconstrained peaks. No p-values or common receiver/preprocessing assumptions across the scenes.
